title: Caller identity
description:
Who is asking. Everything but `product` is OPAQUE TO OAIY: stored on the run, echoed back, used for grouping and display, never parsed and never branched on.

This replaces FormLogic's `appContext.appSlug`, which was a required field naming a FormLogic-only concept — a coding agent or an OpenAI-compatible client has no app slug and would have to invent one. The moment OAIY special-cases the contents of these fields, the consumer's schema has leaked in and the next consumer has to impersonate the first.

tenantId.description: Opaque owner/tenant id in the caller's own namespace.

scopeId.description: Opaque sub-scope in the caller's namespace. OAIY must not parse this.

label.description: Human-readable, for display and logs. The ONLY field here that may carry PII. Treat as untrusted text.
